# Grid

`layout/grid` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

Items laid out in rows of 1 to 6 columns. The base for product, feature, article and stat grids.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | list of components (content-level) (1 to 24) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Two columns.
- **one-column**: A single column list. Sets `columns: 1`.
- **three-column**: Three columns. Sets `columns: 3`.
- **four-column**: Four columns. Sets `columns: 4`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `1`, `2` | `1` |
| `mobileAlignment` | one of `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right` | `"inherit"` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `2`, `1`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6` | `2` |
| `valign` | one of `top`, `middle`, `bottom` | `"top"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"@spacing.sm"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `1`, `2`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `mobileAlignment`: `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right`. Overrides text alignment below 480px (`inherit` keeps the desktop alignment). Best effort, images depend on the client.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. mobileColumns is ignored. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts drops media queries and shows the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/grid', {
  "items": [
    [
      {
        "component": "content/image",
        "data": {
          "image": {
            "src": "https://placehold.co/280x200/png?text=Linen%20shirt",
            "alt": "Linen shirt product photo"
          }
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "Linen shirt"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h4"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Relaxed fit, sand."
        }
      }
    ],
```
